name: Spring Boot
description: Spring Boot is a Java framework that simplifies enterprise application development by providing auto-configuration, an embedded server, and a mature ecosystem of modules for security, persistence, messaging and more. It allows building robust REST APIs following Clean Architecture principles with very little boilerplate.
opinion: Spring Boot is the enterprise Java market standard. Its ecosystem is massive and the learning curve is worth it: once mastered, it lets you build solid, maintainable backends quickly.
